tool.name: Search Conversations Threads
tool.description: Search child conversations (threads) for a parent conversation. Uses Starships connector action list-conversation-children. Supports pagination cursors and DB-level search via optional q.

q.description: Optional search query (handled server-side by list-conversation-children)

beforeId.description: Cursor: conversation id (must be provided together with beforeUpdatedAt)

conversationId.description: Parent conversation id (optional; defaults to runtime CONVERSATION_ID)

beforeUpdatedAt.description: Cursor: ISO datetime (must be provided together with beforeId)
